name: כלל המנה – xⁿ/ln(ax) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find the following derivative:

\( \displaystyle \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[{{CT:1}}\right] = \) [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Applying the quotient rule
In order to solve this problem we will have to use the quotient rule as follows:
The quotient rule: \( \frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2} \)

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[{{CT:1}}\right] &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{\left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}[{{CT:2}}]\right]\cdot {{CT:3}} - {{CT:2}}\cdot \left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}[{{CT:3}}]\right]}{[{{CT:3}}]^2} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{\left[{{CT:4}}\right]\cdot {{CT:3}} - {{CT:2}}\cdot \left[{{CT:5}}\right]}{{CT:6}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{{{CT:7}} - {{CT:8}}}{{CT:6}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{{CT:9}}{{CT:6}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:10}} \end{array} \]

on_true.feedback: To differentiate a quotient use the rule \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] You cannot get the derivative of a quotient by dividing the derivatives.

You appear to have applied the quotient rule incorrectly. It is \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] It appears that you divided by \(f^2\), not \(g^2\).
